spec: BANK_AND_HOMES v0.1 (design repo, private; D2220-D2249), first slice: the two opening beats (§3.3, D2233) and the re-voiced Civic Bank lines (D2222).
_about: Ours, not a design copy. Sorted after detail_zzz_act2_cover.json (Mom's repeats) and before detail_zzzz_mahopac_dreams.json, so Mom's passbook sits after her daily snack and before her repeat line, and a later Mahopac line never hides it. Both beats are optional talks off Act 2's critical path: Mom's passbook after Supper (story.cv_mom, never inside the Supper scene), then Teller Bodin (raw name Teller Ivo, shown as Bodin by D1766) opens the book after the posting. Save stays pixelpets.save.v2, v 2; new additive story.* keys only; nothing written at load. The built glimmer teller line and the door sign are unchanged.

_placeholders.note: PLACEHOLDER copy (Story to replace; BANK_AND_HOMES §3.3; OPEN_DECISIONS D2222-copy). Every line in this file is a placeholder except the BUILT teller line kept as the earliest glimmer case.

flags.story.bank_book: §3.3 beat 1 (D2233): Mom gave the holder her old Civic Bank passbook (an optional talk after Supper)
flags.story.bank_open: §3.3 beat 2 (D2233): Teller Bodin opened the book at the Civic Bank after the posting; the JARS tab and the dawn dividend appear

bank_book: A better offer pays somewhere. Keep it in a book, not a sock.
She hands you a passbook. Civic Bank. Her name is crossed out; yours is pencilled in.
The teller in High Charity knows me. Bodin. Tell him I said so.
bank_open: Your mother's book. She kept it tidy. The Keepers draw a Cadet's pay on us now.
Your bag stays yours. Jars we keep. Counted at dawn, any day you look in.
He stamps the first page: KEPT.

objPatch._note: §3.3: Mom's passbook key sits before her repeat line (after the daily snack). The teller and the counter re-voice by key; the built line stays the earliest glimmer case, so a glimmer save reads the same until the beats run.

linesFirst.story.side=glimmer & !story.bank_open: We don't hold lanyards. Or Acorns.
linesFirst.story.side=glimmer & story.bank_open: We don't hold lanyards. We do keep old books. Yours is here.
linesFirst.story.bank_open: Counted and kept. Your bag is yours to spend. Your jars, we mind.
linesFirst.story.bank_book & !story.bank_open & !st: Your mother's book? Bring it back once the Keepers post you.

linesSet.else: Your Acorns stay in your bag. Books are for the posted.

linesFirst.story.bank_open: The counter is polished. Your jars are counted here at dusk.
